A signed [[Red Leader In Red 1]] card. Signature attributed to [[Jonathan Quesenberry]] (identification by comparison; see [[Talk:Jonathan Quesenberry]]).

Source: photo posted by _Sols_Golden_Curse_ in [https://www.reddit.com/r/starwarsccg/comments/1n61y5w/does_anyone_recognize_these_signatures/ "Does anyone recognize these signatures?"], r/starwarsccg, Reddit (1 September 2025); original image https://i.redd.it/ydtgeilakmmf1.jpeg (4032 by 3024 pixels). Preserved copy of the post: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027185849/https://swccg.com/snapshots/reddit/r-starwarsccg-1n61y5w.html Internet Archive]. The image URL https://i.redd.it/ydtgeilakmmf1.jpeg could not be archived (Save Page Now returned errors). The photo shows three signed cards; this file is the Red Leader In Red 1 card cropped from box (2640,530)–(3910,2330) and reduced to 600 by 850 pixels. SHA-256 of the uploaded file: 69a7cb6876beb67e2842095dd4aaf991d01c4d9b3cdd8b1909376b9a3088893d.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a single cropped, reduced-size photo of one signed card from a fan's Reddit post, used only to show the signature on the signer's page on a non-commercial fan wiki. The card art is © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. It cannot replace the card or the photo, and no freely licensed image of this signed card is known.
